chapter: Joining and playing with Miles Davis
title: Leaving Miles Davis in 1970
summary: He wanted a change and more freedom, as Miles wanted more specific grooves from the drums.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So do you remember what year or what precipitated your leaving Miles?

I think it was ‘70. Because Ndugu Leon Chancler went to Europe with Miles and the band had Don Alias and Keith and Gary Bartz. When they came back from the summer, Miles called me. They had a few more gigs. Did New York City, maybe one or two other gigs and then I left. I just wanted a change of scenery. I wanted to play a little freer.
